_about: Google Pixel Buds' control protocol, read from Google's Pixel Buds app 1.0.990706425 (com.google.android.apps.wearables.maestro.companion, decompiled outside the repo on 2026-10-30; docs/pixel/PROTOCOL.md). Two transports carry the same protobuf messages: Maestro (Pigweed RPC in HDLC frames) on the Pixel Buds Pro, Pro 2 and 2a, and a plain group/code/length frame on the Pixel Buds (2020) and A-Series. Field numbers are the app's message fields; names come from the app's writers, readers, log strings and preference keys, and for Maestro's service and methods from pbpctrl (github.com/qzed/pbpctrl, Maximilian Luz, MIT or Apache-2.0), whose names hash to the ids a Pixel Buds Pro 2 sent (OpenControl's captures). never_send: firmware update, setup and diagnostics; PairFree refuses them.

maestro._hdlc: pw_hdlc UI frames: 7E, the address (a varint whose last byte has bit 0 set), control 03, the RPC packet, CRC-32 of address to packet (little-endian), 7E; 7D escapes 7D and 7E (xor 20).
maestro._peers: Address = source << 6 | target << 10 (4 bits each); pbpctrl's peers, the app's hmq.
maestro._channels: The RPC channels the phone may reach the earbuds on; pbpctrl, like the app, tries GetSoftwareInfo on each and uses the one that answers.
maestro._packet: pw.rpc.packet.RpcPacket: 1 type, 2 channel_id, 3 service_id (fixed32), 4 method_id (fixed32), 5 payload, 6 status, 7 call_id. Ids are pw_rpc's 65599 hash of the names.

tlv._frame: Group (1 byte), code (1 byte), length (2 bytes, big-endian, at most 1024 from the earbuds), payload (protobuf). No checksum (the app's grp).
tlv._never_send_groups: 2 firmware update, 5 crash reports (A-Series), 130 firmware-update debug (2020), 136 usage statistics.

_messages: The same on both transports: a read names the field in the family's slot (1 common, 2 Pixel Buds 2020, 3 A-Series, 4 Allegro: Pro, Pro 2, 2a); a write and a setting value hold the family's settings message in that slot with one field set.
_settings: Each family's settings message (a oneof). type: bool, enum and int (varints; sint32 zigzag), message (bytes). read: PairFree reads it on connecting. key: the row PairFree shows, or shared: the setting the shared screens know.
_values: Values the settings take (the app's enums and writers).
_noise_cycle: Allegro field 12: which modes press and hold steps through, a bool each; the app asks for at least two.
_eq_mode: Field 12 on the 2020 and A-Series: 0 the default sound, 1 bass boost.
_bass_level: A-Series field 14: the app's slider runs from -1 to 4 and sends its value plus 1.
_balance: Allegro field 17: -100 (left) to 100 (right), 0 in the middle.
_hold_actions: Allegro field 7: field 1 the left earbud, 2 the right, each {4: {1: action}}. The app writes one side at a time and offers these actions for press and hold.
_attention_alerts: 2020 field 9: 1 on, 2 a baby crying, 3 a dog barking, 4 sirens.
_eq: Allegro fields 16 (the EQ in use) and 18 (the user's saved curve): five floats, low bass to upper treble, -6 to 6 dB; the app's sliders move in 0.5 dB steps. The presets are the app's own (gol.java, and its EQ function's description).
